digest.component_or_area: code-review gate per-pass model class declaration and resolution
propositions: A single model knob (REBAR_LLM_MODEL / cfg.model) cannot express distinct per-pass model classes, so non-default providers like Bedrock cannot run Pass-1 on frontier and Pass-2/Pass-4 on standard.
The code-review gate steps base (Pass-1), round_a and round_b (Pass-1 batch), and coach (Pass-4) declare no per-step model class and implicitly inherit the run's single resolved cfg.model.

Batch steps must declare a single-rung model_ladder rather than a step-level model:, because the batch path reads only the batch sub-dict's model_ladder and silently discards an enclosing step's model: key.

The code-review gate never honors any per-step model declaration at runtime: an inverted-config live run showed all calls, including verify's declared model: standard, resolving to opus instead of the declared classes.

The YAML class declarations are correct in form but inert because the runtime plumbing does not pass step model tokens to the resolver, a pre-existing defect now tracked separately as blocking bug b690.

Tests that assert only that the YAML carries a class token, or that resolve_model_string resolves it, pass vacuously; an end-to-end recording-runner test asserting the model each step actually receives is required.
